AgentUiOrigin.description: Canonical lowercase HTTP or HTTPS origin using localhost, an IPv4 address or a DNS name. Default and invalid ports are forbidden.

created_at.description: Immutable registration time captured when the request binds the bundle.

authority_namespace.description: Immutable service execution namespace. Retired namespaces cannot admit execution.

next_offset.description: Next page offset, or null when no further page is available within the offset limit.

RequestList.description: A page of visible request summaries, without an exact total count.

binding_digest.description: SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 canonical identity fields. The authenticated host and its server-side verification establish trust in this transient presentation commitment.

created_at.description: Immutable registration time captured in the accepted request binding.

producer.description: Authenticated machine principal acting as the producer and agent system.

requester.description: Operator-resolved human owner on whose behalf the producer submitted the request.

binding_digest.description: SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 canonical identity fields. The authenticated host and its server-side verification establish trust in this transient presentation commitment.

AgentUiViewToHostMessage.description: Closed public View-to-Host message union. Error responses in this direction correlate only to Host teardown requests.

AgentUiHostToViewMessage.description: Closed public Host-to-View message union. Error responses in this direction correlate only to View initialize or propose requests.

AgentUiProxyToHostNotification.description: Private outer-Proxy-to-Host lifecycle notifications. These messages never cross the public View boundary.

AgentUiHostToProxyNotification.description: Private Host-to-outer-Proxy resource notification. This message never crosses the public View boundary.

AgentUiMessage.description: Closed public Agent UI version 2 message union. Directional validators enforce the fixed initialize, initialized, input, result, optional proposals and terminal teardown lifecycle. Private Proxy notifications are excluded.

AgentUiLimits.description: Fixed Agent UI version 2 transport, lifecycle and text budgets. Message byte limits apply to UTF-8 encoded JSON, and json_depth counts the root as depth zero.

AgentUiLifecycle.description: Fixed Agent UI version 2 lifecycle. Messages outside this order are invalid for the active View instance.

producerBearer.description: Separately provisioned machine credential; no human confirmation authority
